choosePrior: Choose an earlier package to amend
nameAdapter: Enter a name for the adapter.
chooseFilesFirst: Select the original files to include.
checkingFiles: Reading selected files and calculating their digests…
targetChanged: The destination record changed. Choose its current revision to review this package again.
title: Continuing intake
intro: Validate a proposal for this saved record, stage its files privately, then review and apply it. Your existing manual evidence tools remain available.
changes: This proposal also amends the saved record. The amended record will be private.
validationOnly: Validation does not import files or establish physical execution, measurement accuracy or independent scientific verification.
noProposals: No saved proposals for this record.
changedEvidence: Evidence has changed since this receipt was linked. It does not satisfy the current completion policy.
unboundEvidence: This older receipt has no evidence snapshot. Link a new receipt to satisfy the current completion policy.
preparedOnly: Choose a prepared edition containing this saved record revision. This links its preparation; it does not publish it or confirm a live deployment.
noEditions: No prepared editions containing this record on this page. Prepare an edition from Publishing or check older editions.
readinessIntro: These checks summarize saved evidence and receipts. They do not determine a scientific outcome or replace review.

reviewCount.one: {count} pending or unresolved review; {changed} reviews of earlier revisions
reviewCount.other: {count} pending or unresolved reviews; {changed} reviews of earlier revisions

declared: User-declared receipt; not an independent verification.
policyHelp: These receipts are required before a saved record in this project can be marked completed. Receipt requirements are optional; negative results can still be completed. Save changed content before linking receipts and marking it completed.
stale: The record or workspace changed. Reopen intake from the saved record.
jobStopped: This job stopped. Its staged files remain private and can be resumed.
cliHelp:
node src/cli.js intake --action <preview|stage|apply|status|cancel|resume|list|readiness|watch> --workspace <directory> --workspace-id <UUID> --record-id <UUID> [--source <proposal-directory>] [--id <proposal-UUID>] [--pin <SHA-256>] [--wait] [--password-stdin]
Intake always returns versioned JSON. Stage and apply require the reviewed pin. --wait runs the shared worker until that job stops. Watch only notifies about proposals in child folders; it never applies them.
